newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank lowers overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank lowers overnight rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Friday it had reduced its benchmark overnight borrowing rate by one percentage point to 13.0 percent from 14.0 percent.
The overnight lending rate was likewise cut to 15.0 percent from 16.0 percent.
Central Bank treasurer Sergio Edeza said the rate adjustment was effected after the peso-dollar exchange rate had normalised.
The Central Bank raised its overnight rates last month to ward off speculation on the peso at the height of the Thai baht problems.
The rate cut had been anticipated by money market traders.
